scope: Shared development source and disposable synthetic local candidates only
implemented: Extend existing authenticated universal search with Payments and Notes filters alongside the original five filters

Search payment IDs, provider references, customer contact details, authoritative service addresses and quoted services; preserve signed recorded amounts and paid/pending/failed/tip/refund distinctions
Search customer note bodies and identifying contacts; return bounded excerpts around matches rather than full private note bodies

Explicit selection refreshes customer records and focuses the exact payment or note in its owning customer profile; unavailable targets show a recoverable warning rather than silently using stale rows
Preserve unsaved note drafts separately by customer in memory while CustomersView remains mounted; switching customers never carries another customer's draft
Retain no-store/private reads, owner authentication, bounded results, literal parameter binding, generation guards and existing responsive search behavior
No search-triggered financial mutation, note submission, persistent record index, schema change or hosted operation

verification.routeContracts: 90/90 per QA, LIVE, Doomsday and staging isolated candidates; includes existing invoice-number/contact/service/property guards and added payment/reference/note/auth/filter/unchanged-record contracts
verification.builtQaNativeD1HttpsChromium: 75/75, including 28 metadata checks: exact payment/note focus, identifying details, bounded excerpts, 320/390/768/1366 viewport geometry, per-customer draft isolation, unavailable refreshed target and explicit recovery, unchanged financial/note backup tables
verification.networkIsolation: No external network dispatched or uncaught client errors; no map-frame exemption used by metadata fixtures
verification.customerLoadRecovery: 1460/1460 mocked read/error/stale/unmount checks on QA and LIVE candidates
verification.paymentsHeader: 111/111 phone/tablet/desktop light/dark payment entry, keyboard, navigation and loading assertions
verification.financial: 194 invoice-current-state and 208 customer/invoice-balance assertions per four candidates; processing-fee and public-document suites per four; final-tipping suite on LIVE candidate

limitations: Full Step 152 search acceptance remains open: dedicated property results, photo/document metadata and isolated encrypted offline search are not implemented here
Note drafts are in mounted-view memory only, not durable across reload, logout or navigation away from CustomersView
Existing SQLite case handling retained; full Unicode normalization not verified
Financial results describe stored records and never prove provider settlement or return of funds
No hosted deployment, actual iPhone/iPad Safari keyboard acceptance or production release approval claimed
Deposit exceptions, hosted latency investigation, broader status/notification work and other unaccepted release gates remain open
nextBatch: Implement safe dedicated property search and navigation using existing property gates, then address remaining metadata coverage without persisting an unencrypted offline index
